structure.definition: Binary symmetric rook Moran I; ceil(percent*N) top masses; exact top-5 Jaccard; one independently seeded shuffle per map. Constant-map I is undefined.

geometry.rule: Differential hidden[0]: true >= .95 for all layouts; a,b,d transpose >= .10 lower. Hidden[8] and random controls are reported, not gated.
geometry.interpretation: Per-cell d = L2(h_Y - h_X); an exact 1-D two-means split of d alone predicts the high-distance group as changed. Agreement excludes boundary-straddling cells. Position terms cancel between paired inputs; vision/LLM mixing can spread differences. Figure pairs share a colour scale within each layer. Processor calibration is unchanged.

recompute.rule: All 24 L1 distances <= .15; answering viewer within 1e-4; final token is endoftext.

sinks.hidden_state_convention: Attention layer l uses hidden_states[l+1] output; layer 27 output has terminal RMSNorm. Mean L2 across outputs 16..27; max_abs is the maximum over their layers and channels. Text = instruction tokens.

objects.definition: Object cells have their 32x32 cell centre inside the disc silhouette; fractional metrics weight each cell by silhouette pixel coverage.

sheet.rendering: Prepared image JPEG quality 90; jet alpha .5, nearest; ranks use average ties.
